meta.title: Roma migrations · South Asia to the global diaspora
meta.description: Seven-phase supplied reconstruction, with 28 wave rows retained, Roma/Sinti primary and Dom/Lom comparative. Modern net-mobile weights are not a census of present-day Roma. Default 1 dot = 1,000 people. Source low/central/high values are visualization scenarios, not censuses or statistical confidence intervals. Unknown archival headcounts stay null. Genetic effective size and ancestry percentages are not converted into added people. Dated descendant-support priors are disclosed bookkeeping assumptions, not observed births or local admixture.

sources.title: MERI (2024), field research on Iraqi Roma and related communities

sources.title: ERRC Turkey country profile (2011–2012; information current to April2013)
sources.note: Roma concentrated in western Anatolia, Thrace, Marmara and Aegean; Dom southeast and Lom northeast/east BlackSea. Combined500,000–5,000,000 range includes Roma,Dom,Lom,Abdal and is not a Romanlar-only count.

sources.title: ERRC / Helsinki Citizens’ Assembly / Edirne Roman association (2008), We Are Here!
